meta.title: Scenario: compressed ratings (Granary Cooperative)
meta.notes: Fictional data, generated by scripts/generate-scenarios.ts (compressed-ratings) with seed 20261103. 24 members in three teams, every rating given. Seventeen respondents avoided both ends of every scale (2 to 4 on the 0–5 scales, 0 to +2 on valence, never negative); MIL05, BAK06, DIS03 gave every colleague the same answer (3, and +1 on valence); only MIL02, BAK03, DIS01, DIS07 used the whole scale. The underlying teams are distinct (Milling and Distribution barely work together), and four Bakery members (BAK02, BAK03, BAK05, BAK07) have strained relationships that only BAK03 reports as negative.
